Before, IRC was used.
If you're looking to come in contact with someone special, or anyone at all in the community, this is the place for you. Quakeworld is famous for its tight and welcoming community, still going strong since [[1996]].


Feel free to ask questions about anyting related to Quakeworld, and you should find an answer quickly.
